ns2:section.sectionText: OIIR Dialogue Course. Topic: Being White in a Multicultural Society. COURSE DAYS AND TIMES SUBJECT TO CHANGE. Offered in collaboration with the Office of Inclusion and Intercultural Relations (OIIR) ENROLLEMENT INFORMATION available at http://studentaffairs.illinois.edu/diversity/pir/DSJEPCourses.html. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can email intergrouprelations@illinois.edu. Application Dates: Feb 02 2010-Mar 20, 2010; Priority Deadline: Feb. 16, 2010.
